actions.fist_thumb_left: no action - recorded so a thumb-out fist is not mistaken for a fist
actions.fist_thumb_right: no action - recorded so a thumb-out fist is not mistaken for a fist

instructions.none: Relax. Move your hand naturally, rest it, gesture while talking - anything that is NOT one of the command poses. Vary it every repetition.
instructions.point: Extend the index finger only. Thumb tucked against the palm, other three fingers curled.
instructions.pinch: Touch the thumb tip to the index fingertip. Middle, ring and pinky loosely curled.
instructions.pinch_right: Touch the thumb tip to the MIDDLE fingertip while keeping the index finger clearly extended.
instructions.open_palm: All five fingers extended and spread. Move the palm slowly side to side while recording.
instructions.v_sign: Index and middle extended in a WIDE V. Ring and pinky curled, thumb tucked.
instructions.two_finger_scroll: Index and middle extended and held TOGETHER, touching. Move slowly up and down while recording.
instructions.fist: Closed fist with the thumb tucked across the front of the fingers, not sticking out.
instructions.fist_thumb_up: Closed fist with the thumb extended straight UP.
instructions.fist_thumb_left: Closed fist with the thumb extended sideways to the LEFT.
instructions.fist_thumb_right: Closed fist with the thumb extended sideways to the RIGHT.

conditions.label: Normal
conditions.instruction: Sit at your usual presenting distance, hand at chest height, centred in the frame.

conditions.label: Close to camera
conditions.instruction: Move roughly one arm-length closer, so the hand fills much more of the frame.

conditions.label: Far from camera
conditions.instruction: Lean back or step away, so the hand is noticeably smaller in the frame.

conditions.label: Rotated hand
conditions.instruction: Hold the same pose but rotate the wrist - tilt left, right, and angle the palm away from the camera. Change the tilt every repetition.

conditions.label: Off-centre
conditions.instruction: Hold the pose near an edge or corner of the frame instead of the middle.

left_hand.note: The product reads only open_palm (controls lock) and fist (voice recording) from the left hand. These trials are a held-out check that mirroring right-hand training data into the left hand's frame actually holds.

quality._min_edge_margin_note: Deliberately just above zero. The gate exists to reject hands clipped by the frame edge, where MediaPipe extrapolates landmarks that were never observed. A larger value would fight the offcentre condition, which asks for exactly that placement.
